articles.title: Google Optimizes Agent Development Kit's 200K-line Python Codebase Overnight with Gemini 4 Argon
articles.author: Sergio De Simone
articles.summary: Google explained how an 11-hour unattended run of Gemini 4 Argon produced two accepted optimizations for Google Agent Development Kit's codebase, reducing in-memory session-preparation overhead by about 40% in long sessions and cold package import time by 21%. By Sergio De Simone

articles.title: Google’s Data Agent Kit Hits GA, Splitting Agent Guardrails Between Skills and IAM
articles.author: Steef-Jan Wiggers
articles.summary: Google has made Data Agent Kit generally available, a free set of MCP tools and 37 open-source skills that connect coding agents to more than fifteen Google Data Cloud services. Two kinds of guardrail ship with it, and practitioners need to tell them apart: one is a skill asking the agent to stop, the other an IAM deny policy that refuses the call. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
